scoring_justification: T1 recompute from raw DFT artifacts is infeasible in the verifier; T0 result-level compare with paper's reported magnetic moments is acceptable.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold magnetic moments and total energy sanity range
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper-reported values: 4μB (unrelaxed), 0μB (relaxed), 4μB (H-passivated). Energy range derived from expected QE total energy for 92 C atoms.
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper text; energy range set to admit plausible DFT energies.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own numbers for the same quantities; energy range is a generous sanity check, not a fabricated exact target.

magnetic_moment.description: Total magnetic moment in Bohr magnetons (μB)

outputs.description: An array of three objects, ordered: unrelaxed, relaxed, hydrogen_saturated. Each object contains the condition name, total magnetic moment in Bohr magnetons, and total energy in eV.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare magnetic_moment and total_energy to hidden reference values within appropriate tolerances. The exact DFT implementation details (plane-wave cutoff, k-mesh density, convergence thresholds) are left to the solver, as long as they follow standard practices for this system.
